testcase.name: Tier 1: conversions follow IEEE-754 for NaN and infinities and never throw (section 6)
Constants: 20 ticks per second, 50,000,000 ns per tick, and their product is exactly one second (section 2)
secondsToTicks is seconds * 20.0; the seconds round trip is not exact for large counts, so authoritative ticks never come from seconds (section 2)
ticksToSeconds is ticks / 20.0, the correctly rounded quotient, not ticks * 0.05 (section 2)
